title: Strategy & Innovation in the XR Economy
description: In this session, Virginie Maillard, Head of Global Research in Simulation and Digital Twin at Siemens, will explore how integrating digital twins, AI, and immersive technologies can enhance performance and sustainability in manufacturing processes. Following the presentation, a fireside chat with Trishna Lovley and Nancy Soignoli will delve deeper into the strategic integration of experiential technologies, highlighting how organizations can move beyond mere adoption to purposeful application, ensuring that technology serves as a meaningful tool for advancement rather than just the latest trend.
